description: This file implements the core socket port functionalities for a cross-platform networking library, including socket creation, configuration, data transmission, and event handling for different operating systems (Windows, POSIX). It defines the SocketPort class with methods for opening, closing, reading, writing, and managing socket options, as well as handling multicast groups and socket events.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Initializes Windows Sockets API (Winsock) and retrieves function pointers for advanced socket operations.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, handling platform-specific control message parsing for interface index.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Configures a socket to operate in non-blocking mode.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on local node info and interface specifications.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Adjusts socket buffer sizes and allocates aligned buffers for send/receive operations.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits until the socket is open or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits until all pending write operations are completed or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits until the socket is closed or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Retrieves the current event flags for the socket, indicating readiness for I/O operations.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events based on the flags set, triggering read, write, accept, or close actions.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into the receive buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data from the send buffer over the socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens and connects or binds the socket based on configuration.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Signals the socket to process pending events.
